comment: Trigger boundary for Kotlin source/tooling work, including mixed JVM and Multiplatform changes, without absorbing Android or generic workflows.

queries.query: Fix copy and mutability semantics for this Kotlin data class used only by Kotlin callers; no Java source or Java-facing JVM contract is involved.
Update this Kotlin Multiplatform source-set dependency without changing unrelated targets.
Add a subcommand to this Kotlin command-line tool that parses a CSV of shipments and posts each one to the tracking API.
Repair this callbackFlow adapter so cancellation unregisters its Kotlin listener exactly once and a slow collector cannot make buffering unbounded; no Java source or Java-facing API changes.
Use $kotlin-development to review this coroutine cancellation path and its tests.
Change only an Android XML layout and its resource colors; no Kotlin or build files are involved.
Define trunk-based merge rules for this Kotlin repository without changing source or tooling.
Fix cancellation in a Kotlin Android ViewModel and update its lifecycle-aware collection.
Change a public Java interface and its Kotlin implementation's nullability contract, preserving the JVM signatures used by supported Java and Kotlin callers.
